text: Oh, that's a very deep question.

speaker: A

text: I think music is a kind of culture, and globalization will definitely influence culture.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Different countries have different cultures, and globalization spreads cultures around and influences them.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Music is one of the ways that happens.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Like in America, there's hip-hop — it developed because there were people who wanted to express their feelings in a stronger way.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And in China, with the economy developing, people face the same needs.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So hip-hop music came to China and developed here, because we now have the same need to express ourselves — just like America did before.
